title: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: This Cookie Policy explains how Poornaphala Media and Infotech Services LLP (“The School Expert™”, “we”, “us” or “our”) may use cookies and similar technologies when you visit www.schoolexpert.in and related pages, forms and services (the “Platform”).
This policy should be read together with our Privacy Policy. It describes the types of technologies that may be used, why they may be used and the choices available to you.

title: 2. What are cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files that a website may place on your device when you visit it. They help a website recognise a browser or device and remember certain information, such as session status or preferences.

We may also use similar technologies, including local storage, pixels, tags, scripts and software development tools. In this policy, we refer to these technologies collectively as “cookies” unless the context requires otherwise.

title: 3. Why we use cookies
paragraphs: Cookies may help us operate the Platform, keep it secure, remember your preferences, understand how visitors use pages and improve website performance and user experience.
The specific cookies and technologies used may vary depending on the features available on the Platform, the page you visit, your device and the settings you choose.

title: 4. Types of cookies we may use
paragraphs: Strictly necessary cookies: These may be required for core website functions, security, network management, page navigation or access to features you request. The Platform may not function properly without them.
Functional or preference cookies: These may remember choices such as language, region or other settings to provide a more consistent experience.
Analytics or performance cookies: Where enabled, these may help us understand traffic, page usage, errors and general interaction patterns so that we can assess and improve the Platform.

Advertising or measurement cookies: If introduced, these may be used to measure campaigns, limit repeated advertisements or understand whether an advertisement or referral led to a visit. We do not represent that advertising cookies are currently active on every part of the Platform.

title: 5. First-party and third-party cookies
paragraphs: First-party cookies are set by the website you are visiting. Third-party cookies or similar technologies may be set by service providers whose tools or content are integrated into a page, for example analytics, embedded media, security or other website services.

Third-party providers may process information under their own privacy and cookie policies. Their technologies, availability and practices may change. We encourage you to review the relevant provider policies where applicable.

title: 6. Session and persistent cookies
paragraphs: Session cookies are generally temporary and are removed when you close your browser. Persistent cookies may remain on your device for a defined period or until you delete them.

The duration of a cookie depends on its purpose and the settings applied by the website or relevant provider. We aim to use retention periods appropriate to the purpose for which the technology is used.

title: 7. Your choices and managing cookies
paragraphs: You can usually manage cookies through your browser settings. Depending on your browser, you may be able to view, block, restrict or delete cookies, or configure the browser to notify you when cookies are being set.

If a cookie preference or consent tool is presented on the Platform, you can use the controls made available there to manage the relevant optional technologies. Your choices may need to be applied separately on different browsers or devices.
Please note that blocking or deleting certain cookies may affect website features, saved preferences, security functions or the overall operation of the Platform.

title: 8. Consent and applicable law
paragraphs: Where consent is required by applicable law for a particular cookie or similar technology, we will seek consent through an appropriate mechanism before using that technology, except where a lawful exemption applies, such as for technologies strictly necessary to provide a service you have requested.
You may withdraw or change a consent choice where the relevant controls are provided. Withdrawal does not affect processing that took place before the withdrawal.

title: 9. Information collected through cookies
paragraphs: Depending on the technology and its purpose, information may include browser or device information, approximate location derived from technical information, pages viewed, time spent, referring pages, interaction events, identifiers and diagnostic or performance information.

We do not intend to use cookies to collect information beyond what is reasonably relevant to their stated purposes. Please refer to our Privacy Policy for further information about how personal data is handled.

title: 10. Updates to this Cookie Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Cookie Policy to reflect changes in the Platform, technologies, service providers, business practices or applicable legal requirements. The revised policy will be published on this page with an updated date where appropriate.
We encourage you to review this page periodically so that you remain informed about our use of cookies and similar technologies.

title: 11. Contact us
paragraphs: If you have questions about this Cookie Policy or our use of cookies and similar technologies, you can contact Poornaphala Media and Infotech Services LLP, operating as The School Expert™.
Email: info@schoolexpert.in | Website: www.schoolexpert.in

title: 12. Important notice
paragraphs: This Cookie Policy is a general policy drafted for The School Expert™ and describes cookie categories that a website may use. It is not confirmation that every category or technology described here is currently deployed on the Platform.

Before publication, the policy should be checked against the Platform’s actual cookies, scripts, embedded services, consent mechanism and retention settings. We recommend review by qualified legal counsel to confirm compliance with applicable Indian law and any other laws that may apply to visitors.
